identification.visual_evidence: The intact Fig7 caption identifies Bancroft's first commercially used machine as the Limited Font Machine,132characters. The article describes commercial practicality in1897; its chronology distinguishes the earlier1887 compression machine,1891 and1893 machines from this limited-font design.
identification.date_of_model_vs_photo: 1897 identifies the historical machine model;1924 is the confirmed publication date of the reproduced photograph. The exposure date is not established.
identification.museum_record: SMG2024-452, limited-font SizeA, Washington1897, serial44, confirms the model/date. The record offered no directly observable object photograph; do not label the acquired periodical image as a photograph of that particular surviving example.
identification.source_reliability_limit: The digitiser warns that Bullen's historical narratives contain errors. The specific image identification is explicit in the original caption and model/date are corroborated independently by the museum; this report does not endorse every assertion in the article.

selected_asset.content: Complete historical photograph plus the complete original Fig7 caption, retained byte-identically as downloaded.
selected_asset.appearance: Original printed halftone, paper texture and signs of age remain. Do not recolor, sharpen with generative tools or reconstruct machine parts.
selected_asset.optional_native_clip_proposal: A native clip may show only the whole machine photograph, stopping before the printed Fig7 caption, while retaining the complete PNG below it and providing a new editorial citation. Exact crop and final display size still require visual QA; no crop has been applied.
